description: This Java class is a Spring MVC Controller named DigitalProductController, responsible for managing digital products within an e-commerce platform's admin module. It includes endpoints for viewing, saving, and removing digital product files, with role-based access control annotations.

classes.name: DigitalProductController
classes.description: A Spring MVC Controller for managing digital products, including viewing, saving, and deleting digital product files within the admin section.

methods.name: getDigitalProduct
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve and display a digital product by its ID, verifying store ownership.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a digital product file, including validation and processing uploaded files.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a digital product file by its ID, with validation and JSON response.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private helper method to set the menu context for the admin interface.
